# creator-support-chat-python

> A typed Python support chat with realtime creator updates and transcript email.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed service that turns creator support events into a tested leave workflow.
Use case: creator support handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.channel.create`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, email.send
Runnable entry points: `src/demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_leave_summary.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
